task_overview.problem: 175+ inline SVG icons are scattered across 25+ files with duplicate definitions and inconsistent sizing (h-4 w-4, h-5 w-5, h-6 w-6) and stroke widths
task_overview.goal: Create a centralized, reusable icon component system
benefits: Reduce bundle size by eliminating duplication
Enable consistent iconography across the application
Simplify icon updates (change once, apply everywhere)

patterns.ui_component_location: components/ui/ directory for reusable UI elements
patterns.client_components: Use 'use client' directive for interactive components
patterns.styling: Tailwind CSS utility classes with dark mode support
patterns.export_pattern: Export from index.ts for clean imports

existing_implementations.description: Project has inline SVG icons with Tailwind classes (h-4 w-4, h-5 w-5, h-6 w-6) and varying strokeWidth values
relevant_files: app/(dashboard)/products/page.tsx - Contains eye, eye-off, edit, delete, plus icons
